recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future broader translation-extension policy for vital signs source units should be handled as a new or explicitly reopened issue, not as remaining FHIR-27004 work.
issue_request: FHIR-27004 was an Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification OO issue for R6 that originally asked to relax core vital-signs unit requirements to allow a standard converted unit in the ISO 21090 PQ translation extension while preserving source units. The final resolution instead added oz_av to the units value set rather than relaxing the body-weight profile requirement.
initial_application: No FHIR-27004-labeled source commit was found. The FHIR-27004 Jira comments point to FHIR-49972 and applied git 90f6f81f6c, with follow-up commit 8515a4fcf4 completing the bodyweight binding text.
additional_context: The #implementers Core vitals Units thread documented the original source-unit concerns, weight-in-oz data, and the suggestion to add oz_av. Later FHIR-43353 separately relaxed the general VitalSigns ucum-vitals-common binding to preferred, but FHIR-27004's final bodyweight-specific decision was the narrower ounce addition. Observation is active in the current build, and FHIR-39153 confirms the affected value sets remain in FHIR core.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source keeps the bodyweight profile required binding to ucum-bodyweight while allowing '[oz_av]' in the bodyweight value set and binding description, and the common vital-signs value set also contains '[oz_av]'.
